基地台首选线性电源（纹波小、无干扰），便携用磷酸铁锂电池。: For a base station prefer a linear supply (low ripple, no interference); for portable use, LiFePO4 batteries.
多数电台按 13.8V（对应 12V 铅酸浮充）设计，稳压电源应输出 13.8V: Most radios are designed for 13.8 V (corresponding to the float charge of a 12 V lead-acid battery), so a regulated supply should output 13.8 V.
开关电源若用于 HF 接收，需选择电磁兼容好、带屏蔽的产品，必要时加共模扼流圈。: If a switching supply is used for HF reception, pick a well-shielded product with good electromagnetic compatibility, and add a common-mode choke if necessary.
无纹波与干扰，便携与应急首选，注意电压范围。: No ripple or interference; the first choice for portable and emergency use — mind the voltage range.
电流在电源线与接头上产生的电压降，大功率发射时需粗线短距离供电。: The voltage drop produced by current in the supply leads and connectors; when running high power, feed with thick cable over a short distance.
电源应有限流与短路保护，防止故障时烧毁设备。: The supply should have current limiting and short-circuit protection to keep a fault from burning out the equipment.
电源线用足线径并可靠压接，避免接头松动导致压降与发热。: Use power leads of adequate gauge with reliable crimping, so loose connections do not cause voltage drop and heating.
电源额定电流应大于电台最大发射电流，并留约 20% 余量。: The supply's rated current should exceed the radio's maximum transmit current, with about 20% headroom.
纹波小、无高频干扰，但笨重、效率低、发热大。: Low ripple and no RF interference, but bulky, inefficient and hot.
轻便高效，但可能产生高频噪声干扰接收。: Light and efficient, but may produce RF noise that interferes with reception.
输出电压中的交流残余，线性电源纹波小，劣质开关电源纹波大会引入「嗡嗡」声。: The AC residue in the output voltage; linear supplies have small ripple, while poor switching supplies with large ripple introduce a "hum".
